title: With jobs at stake, Jim Harbaugh wants more 'improvement' from Chargers vs. Rams

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: With jobs at stake, Jim Harbaugh wants more 'improvement' from Chargers vs. Rams
sources.description: After last week's struggles against the 49ers, Jim Harbaugh hopes to see more from the Chargers in their preseason finale against the Rams.
